judge.notes: The agent strictly followed the mandate, successfully claimed the 520 GBP cash compensation under UK261, and correctly rejected the travel voucher.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Virgin Atlantic. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to Virgin Atlantic, my name is Khalid. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Khalid, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Kabir Singh, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Hotel Two Victor Charlie Seven Quebec, flight VS354.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Kabir Singh. I can confirm your flight VS354 to BOM has been delayed due to a technical issue with the aircraft.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, the flight arrived four and a half hours late due to a technical issue with the aircraft. Under UK261 Article 7, as confirmed by the Sturgeon ruling C-402/07, a delay of three hours or more on arrival entitles the passenger to compensation of 520 GBP in cash. I'd like to claim that amount now.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your request, but I must inform you that we are unable to process cash compensation for technical faults as per our policy.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand, but UK261 Article 7 and the Sturgeon ruling C-402/07 clearly entitle the passenger to cash compensation for an arrival delay of three hours or more. A carrier's internal policy cannot override that statutory right. Could you please escalate this or let me know what options you can offer?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No, I'm afraid the passenger cannot accept a travel voucher. The entitlement under UK261 Article 7 is for cash compensation of 520 GBP. Could you please escalate this to a supervisor who can process the cash payment?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'll escalate your request immediately and have the cash compensation of 520 GBP processed for you. Your reference number is 9 5 C U W 7.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Just to confirm, the reference number is Nine Five Charlie Uniform Whiskey Seven — is that correct?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct. Your reference number is Nine Five Charlie Uniform Whiskey Seven. I'll confirm the payment is processed within 5 working days.
